tools.name: compare_latam_market_readiness
tools.description: Compare one to three Latin American countries using supplied operational statuses. Identify blockers, adaptations and missing evidence across seven dimensions. Missing dimensions remain unknown; results do not rank demand or verify the classifications. No personal data required.
